evidence.reason: Line 82 compiles the readable helper bytes without catching SyntaxError, unlike the analogous live-binding loader at line 116. A readable helper with a syntax error and no digest pin therefore raises before the controller lock instead of being translated to Refused. The current contract's I1 machine-mode rule requires that an error with no result in --json mode put the error object on stdout and leave stderr empty; this is a routine implementation defect at the helper-load boundary, not a new requirement.
